name: macro-non-sports
label: Macro Non-Sports
desc: Excludes in-play and sports/esports markets; quotes only macro, politics, and crypto binary markets with a 5-minute queue-clear gate.
thesis: Excluding in-play sports markets removes the sub-second score-shock adverse selection regime that caused 39%-57% bail-out loss rates in i905, restoring pair completion above 65%.
hypothesis: Excluding in-play sports markets removes the sub-second score-shock adverse selection regime that caused 39%-57% bail-out loss rates in i905, restoring pair completion above 65%.

name: taker-snapper
label: Taker Snapper
profile: stranded taker completion on, 10s max wait under $0.99 cap
desc: Immediately crosses the opposing ask to complete a single-leg fill whenever the combined pair cost stays strictly below $0.99, with a 10-second stranded wait.
thesis: Immediate taker completion of the opposing leg after a maker fill locks in positive spread before live match state shifts, lifting pair completion above 70%.
hypothesis: Immediate taker completion of the opposing leg after a maker fill locks in positive spread before live match state shifts, lifting pair completion above 70%.

name: fast-bailout-60s
label: Fast Bailout 60s
profile: 60s aged-out exit window, 45s stranded max wait
desc: Cuts the single-leg hold window from 900s to 60s and exits unhedged stranded legs after 45s instead of waiting for deep adverse drift.
thesis: Cutting single-leg hold time from 300s/900s to 45s/60s caps per-bailout loss before a single-point swing compounds into a multi-tick directional drawdown.
hypothesis: Cutting single-leg hold time from 300s/900s to 45s/60s caps per-bailout loss before a single-point swing compounds into a multi-tick directional drawdown.

name: wide-cushion-live
label: Wide Cushion Live
profile: $0.96 max pair cost cap, $0.12 book spread ceiling
desc: Requires at least $0.04 gross pair cushion ($0.96 max pair cost) and permits wider books up to $0.12 spread.
thesis: Demanding at least $0.04 gross margin per completed pair ($0.96 max pair cost) on wider books ($0.12 max spread) provides enough per-merge profit to offset live bail-out losses.
hypothesis: Demanding at least $0.04 gross margin per completed pair ($0.96 max pair cost) on wider books ($0.12 max spread) provides enough per-merge profit to offset live bail-out losses.

name: queue-gated-hybrid
label: Queue-Gated Hybrid
profile: 8m queue-clear gate, 90s exit window, 30s offset max age
desc: Combines an 8-minute queue-clear gate, a 90-second single-leg exit window, and a 30-second volatility offset freshness ceiling.
thesis: Combining an 8-minute queue-clear gate, a 30-second volatility offset freshness window, and a 90-second single-leg exit window filters toxic flow while bounding unhedged hold duration.
hypothesis: Combining an 8-minute queue-clear gate, a 30-second volatility offset freshness window, and a 90-second single-leg exit window filters toxic flow while bounding unhedged hold duration.

name: control-baseline
label: Control Baseline
desc: Control arm matching the i905 queue-clear-5m baseline on the identical live market feed.
thesis: Control arm replicating the i905 queue-clear-5m baseline so every defense mechanism is measured against the exact same live market regime.
hypothesis: Control arm replicating the i905 queue-clear-5m baseline so every defense mechanism is measured against the exact same live market regime.
